A.rationale: All 5 skeptics returned 'holds' and none landed an evidence-backed refutation. The effect is large and CI-clean: probe_01 C1 (META->L1+L2) HR delta=+0.00906, rel=+130.9%, CI=[+0.00790,+0.01022] excludes 0 by ~7x its half-width across n=49,998; NDCG corroborates (delta +0.00272, rel +209.7%, CI excludes 0). It is NOT an L2 artifact: the META->L1 step alone is +0.00788 HR (+113.9%), and L1-alone (probe_02 HR=0.01495) already more than doubles META (0.00645). It replicates on a disjoint 20K sample (probe_02: META 0.00645 -> L1+L2 0.01625). The two strongest attacks both fail against the same data: (a) the length-confound is dead because at near-equal added char counts the sign goes +130%/+8%/-13.5% (L3 adds +147 chars yet HURTS), which a monotone-length mechanism cannot produce; (b) shared-metadata vocabulary leakage is differenced out by the per-user paired ladder (bootstrap resamples diff=b-a, _probe_common.py:336; all variants share one item order and one fixed user sample). It holds in the cold-start 2-4 bracket too (+0.020, CI [+0.0142,+0.0258]). The only honest caveat is construct-level (this measures 'LLM attribute text retrieves embedding-similar next purchases better than raw H&M metadata' under a buy-similar proxy, not 'discovery'), but META and L1 are scored under the identical operator so the comparison is fair and the proxy cannot fabricate a 2.3x gain. No surviving non-semantic explanation.

B.rationale: No skeptic refuted B (0 refuted), but the modal verdict is 'uncertain' (3 uncertain, 2 holds), and the two 'holds' votes explicitly demote it to a fragile, regime-dependent positive. The direction is real and not a length artifact: L2 adds +177 chars yet helps while L3 adds +147 yet hurts (sign flip kills monotone length); L2-alone beats META by +66% (probe_02: 0.0107 vs 0.00645) even though it is as abstract as L3, which is the key control showing the proxy does not structurally punish abstraction; aggregate 17/21 robustness cells positive, 8/21 significant, 0 significant-negative, and it strengthens monotonically at k=50 (all 6 centroid pooled/50+ cells sig-positive, rel +11% to +26%). BUT the headline '+7.8%, CI excludes 0' is NOT robust at the pre-registered operating point (k=12): the canonical 50k run excludes 0 (CI [+0.00022,+0.00208]) only because n=49,998 — the lower bound sits at ~12% of CI width above 0 and NDCG CI_lo=2.2e-5 grazes zero; at the 20K/k=12 robustness grid, 3 of 4 pooled cells INCLUDE 0 (only seed2024 excludes), and the cold-start 2-4 bracket CI [-0.00028,+0.00473] includes 0 — i.e. L2 is non-significant precisely in the sparse stratum the project most cares about. Under the maxsim lens C2 is never significant (3/3 ns). The legitimate scoping limit: B should be reported as 'L2 = small, directionally-robust real gain whose significance depends on k and sample size; not solid at the deployed k=12 in cold-start.' That is a caveat, not a refutation — there is no significant negative cell and no significant sign flip.

C.rationale: 4 of 5 skeptics returned 'holds'; the single 'refuted' (l3-in-model-advocate) explicitly concedes that 'C3-as: naive-unit-weight-L3-concat-hurts-frozen-retrieval is correct' and refutes only the OVER-CLAIM 'drop-L3-from-the-whole-project.' As SCOPED to frozen-BGE content retrieval, the drop-L3 finding is the most statistically solid of the three: C3 (L1+L2->+L3) HR delta=-0.00216, rel=-13.5%, CI=[-0.00304,-0.00132] excludes 0; across 21 probe_04 cells, 18 negative, 11 significant-negative, and CRITICALLY 0/21 ever significantly positive (no seed, k, stratum, or lens where L3 helps); harm worsens with k (pooled -13.5%@k12 to ~-20%@k50, semantic-dilution signature since length is constant across k). probe_02 corroborates on independent isolations: L1->L1+L3 -13.4% (CI excl 0), L2->L2+L3 -14.5% (CI excl 0), META->L3 exactly 0.0. The two rescue paths a skeptic could use are BOTH dead in-data: (a) the diversity/coverage rescue — L3 also LOSES on diversity (-7.7%, C4 CI [-0.0054,-0.0050] excl 0) and coverage (-2.3%); (b) the 'proxy hates abstraction' rescue — falsified by L2 (equally abstract) thriving. The genuine, conceded scoping limit is CAVEAT D: score_variant builds an unweighted mean-pool centroid (_probe_common.py:191-197) that enters L3 at FIXED weight 1.0 and cannot down-weight it; KAR's trainable Factual Expert + Gate-1/Gate-2 can learn g_L3->0, recovering L1+L2 as a strict special case. L3 is not pure noise (probe_02: L3-alone NDCG 0.00155 > META 0.00126; L1+L3 ~2x META HR), and the frozen harm concentrates in heavy users at large k (50+/k=50 -28% to -39%) rather than the cold-start tail the project targets (2-4/k=12 C3 non-significant in all 3 seeds). Hence: the disposition holds as stated by the probe ('DROP L3 from the content-retrieval method'), but it does NOT license dropping L3 from the trained model; that verdict belongs to the in-model Gate-1/2 test.

synthesis.honest_scoping: WHAT THE PROBES ESTABLISH (frozen-BGE content-retrieval proxy; no model training): Using BGE-base text embeddings + content-based centroid-kNN (L2-normalized unweighted mean of train-history item embeddings -> cosine over the 105K catalog -> top-12), evaluated on held-out val purchases with per-user paired bootstrap CIs, all variants aligned to one item order and one fixed user sample: (1) LLM attribute text (L1) provides a LARGE, robust, CI-clean incremental retrieval gain over raw H&M metadata (+130% pooled HR@12 to L1+L2, of which ~+114% is the META->L1 step alone), replicated on a disjoint sample and confound-controlled against text length and shared metadata vocabulary. (2) L2 (perceptual) adds a SMALL positive increment over L1 that is directionally robust (17/21 cells positive, 0 significant-negative, grows at k=50) and semantically real (not length-driven: +177 chars yet helps; L2-alone beats META standalone), but whose significance is k- and n-dependent and is NOT established at the pre-registered operating point (k=12) in cold-start (2-4 bracket CI includes 0; 3/4 robustness pooled cells at k=12 include 0). (3) Naively concatenating L3 (theory) text at unit weight HURTS retrieval accuracy (-13.5% pooled HR, CI excl 0, 18/21 negative, 0/21 ever sig-positive) AND hurts diversity (-7.7%) and coverage (-2.3%) — so within content retrieval there is no accuracy or diversity rescue for L3. WHAT THE PROBES DO NOT ESTABLISH: (a) Anything about the in-model trainable KAR. The proxy enters every layer at a FIXED, non-learnable weight of 1.0 in an unweighted mean-pool centroid (_probe_common.py:191-197) and structurally CANNOT down-weight a noisy subspace; KAR's Factual Expert + Gate-1/Gate-2 can learn g_L3->0 and recover L1+L2 as a strict special case. The -13.5% therefore bounds the cost of NAIVE unit-weight L3 concatenation, not the value of L3 features under a learned gate. (b) That L3 carries zero learnable signal: probe_02 shows L3-alone NDCG (0.00155) > META (0.00126) and L1+L3 HR ~2x META, so L3 carries retrieval-relevant structure that nets to zero incremental HR only under unweighted pooling. (c) 'Discovery' performance: HR@12-vs-next-purchase under a buy-similar centroid operator is a proxy for relevance/repeat-similarity, not serendipity/novelty (the project's 87%-single-purchase, discovery-oriented mission). (d) Final operating-point significance for L2 at k=12: the crisp '+7.8% CI-excludes-0' depends on the 50k-user run's power; at 20k/k=12 it is borderline.
synthesis.recommended_reframe: Frame the contribution as a confound-free, paired falsification of layer value UNDER A CONTENT-RETRIEVAL PROXY, with the in-model gate as the named arbiter for L3 — do not overstate any layer beyond what the proxy supports. Specifically: (1) HEADLINE (strong, present-tense): 'LLM-extracted product attributes (L1) deliver a large, robust incremental retrieval gain over raw H&M catalog metadata (+114% HR@12 for L1 alone, +131% with L2, CI excludes 0, replicated, length- and vocabulary-confound controlled).' Credit the bulk of the META->L1+L2 lift to L1, not L1+L2 jointly. This directly answers the Triple-Sparsity motivation: content-side LLM text substantially out-retrieves metadata exactly where CF signal is weak (cold-start 2-4 bracket +0.020, CI excl 0). (2) SECONDARY (hedged): 'L2 (perceptual) adds a small, semantically-genuine but regime-dependent increment over L1 — directionally robust and growing with k, but not significant at the deployed k=12 in cold-start. Keep L2; report it as a weak-positive whose significance depends on k and sample size, not as a settled +7.8%.' (3) METHOD-SCOPED NEGATIVE (precise): 'As FROZEN, unit-weight text under content retrieval, L3 (theory) is net-harmful — it dilutes the L1/L2 centroid (-13.5% HR) and also loses on diversity and coverage. We therefore exclude L3 from the content-retrieval/pre-store path.' Do NOT phrase this as 'L3 is useless' or 'drop L3 from the project.' (4) Convert CAVEAT D into a PRE-REGISTERED in-model falsification test rather than a footnote: L3's only surviving rescue is the trainable KAR gate, which the frozen probe is structurally incapable of evaluating; commit in advance to kill L3 from the model iff the learned Gate-2 weight g_L3 -> ~0 AND full L1+L2+L3 KAR fails to beat L1+L2 KAR on MAP@12/HR@12 in the cold-start strata (1, 2-4) with CIs excluding 0. This reframes the result set as: L1 = strong win, L2 = weak-but-real win, L3 = fails the frozen proxy and is on probation pending the gate test — which is both honest and a cleaner research narrative than asserting a 3-layer win.
residual_risks: L3 in-model recoverability (the load-bearing open question): the frozen probe cannot down-weight L3 (unit-weight unweighted mean-pool centroid, _probe_common.py:191-197), so it bounds only naive concatenation. The Gate-1/2 test must resolve whether a learned g_L3 recovers any L3 signal (probe_02 shows L3 is not pure noise: L3-alone NDCG 0.00155 > META 0.00126, L1+L3 ~2x META HR). Pre-register: kill L3 iff learned g_L3 -> ~0 AND L1+L2+L3 KAR does not beat L1+L2 KAR on MAP@12/HR@12 in cold-start strata with CIs excluding 0.

L2 operating-point significance: at the deployed k=12, C2 is non-significant in 3/4 robustness pooled cells and in the 2-4 cold-start bracket; the crisp +7.8% CI-excludes-0 holds only at n=49,998. The in-model run must confirm Gate-2 assigns L2 a stable non-trivial weight with a significant downstream cold-start MAP@12/NDCG@12 lift (CI excl 0); otherwise L2 should be demoted to 'cold-start-only / weak-positive' per the pre-registered C2_weak rule.

Proxy-vs-objective mismatch: HR@12-vs-next-purchase under a buy-similar centroid operator rewards relevance/similarity, not the discovery/serendipity the project's 87%-single-purchase mission targets. Even L1's large win is partly what this proxy is biased to reward. A discovery-native metric (novelty@12, long-tail-hit-rate, serendipity over history-dissimilar items) in-model is needed before claiming discovery gains; note L3 already loses on diversity/coverage, so a discovery rescue for L3 specifically is unlikely.

Where the L3 harm concentrates vs. where the project operates: frozen L3 harm is largest for HEAVY users at large k (50+/k=50, -28% to -39%) — the CF-rich regime where content matters least — and is non-significant in the 2-4 cold-start tail at k=12. A learned gate would route heavy users away from L3; the in-model test must check L3's effect specifically in the sparse strata (1, 2-4) the project exists to serve, not just pooled.

L2 confound not fully subtracted: the probe refutes only a MONOTONE length effect; an inverted-U / saturation length contribution to L2's +8% is not excluded, and no matched-length neutral-filler control exists. A filler-text control (append ~176 chars of shuffled/empty attribute text to L1 and re-score) would cleanly separate L2's perceptual semantics from verbosity; until then a small length/verbosity component cannot be ruled out of the L2 increment.

Generalization beyond frozen BGE + centroid-kNN: all conclusions are conditioned on one encoder (BGE-base, frozen) and one retrieval operator. The maxsim lens partially corroborates direction but with low power (C2 never significant there). The 'L3 needs a different encoder, not deletion' alternative is unfalsified-but-unsupported here; the in-model encoder/fusion variants (E5, fine-tuned BGE, F1-F4) are where it must be tested before final L3 disposition.

A_metadata_vs_llm.objection: Tried to refute, cannot. C1 pooled HR delta=+0.00906, rel=+130.9%, CI=[+0.00790,+0.01022] — the lower bound is 8.7x above zero, not knife-edge. Decomposing: the META->L1 step alone is +0.00788 HR (+113.9%), so the headline does not depend on L2. Independently reproduced in probe_02 on a disjoint 20K sample (META 0.00645 -> L1 0.01495, +132%; -> L1+L2 0.01625). NDCG corroborates (delta +0.00272, rel +209%, CI excludes 0). The bootstrap itself is valid: bootstrap_delta resamples per-user PAIRED differences (diff=b-a, _probe_common.py:336), preserving pairing — the correct estimator. No objection survives the numbers.

B_l2_incremental.objection: The claimed ~+7.8% is real-signed but NOT robustly significant at the project-default config, and the magnitude is practically marginal. (1) Few-user fragility: the default k=12 pooled delta=+0.00118 corresponds to a NET of only 59 users out of 49,998 gaining a hit; CI_lo=0.00022 sits at just 11.8% of the CI width above 0, and the NDCG CI_lo=2.2e-5 essentially touches zero. (2) Seed fragility: in probe_04 at the DEFAULT k=12 pooled, 2 of 3 seeds are non-significant (seed7 rel=+1.5%, CI=[-0.0012,+0.0016] includes 0; seed42 rel=+8.7%, CI=[-0.0002,+0.0030] includes 0); only seed2024 is significant. 13/21 cells have CIs including 0; under the maxsim lens C2 is never significant (3/3 ns). (3) Significance is k-driven: it becomes robust (3/3 seeds sig) only at k=50, not the reported/operational k=12. (4) Practical size: the L2 increment (+0.00118) is only 15% of the META->L1 increment (+0.00788) — about 7x smaller. WHAT SAVES IT FROM 'refuted': the direction is consistent — 17/21 cells positive, ZERO significant-negative, no significant sign flip, and 8/21 sig-positive vs ~2 expected by chance under 42 comparisons. So L2 is directionally robust but its significance at the default k=12 is knife-edge and config-dependent; the honest verdict is 'uncertain / demote to weak-positive', not a clean 'holds'.

C_drop_l3.objection: Tried hardest to flip this and failed. C3 (adding L3 over L1+L2) default pooled HR delta=-0.00216, CI=[-0.00304,-0.00132] excludes 0 (rel -13.5%). Across all 21 probe_04 cells: 18 negative, 0 positive, and CRITICALLY zero significant sign flips to 'L3 helps' (sig_neg=11, sig_pos=0) — there is no cell, seed, k, stratum, or lens where L3 significantly improves accuracy. Magnitude WORSENS with k (k=50 50+: -0.012 to -0.014, all sig). probe_02 C5 corroborates on independent isolations: L1->L1+L3 delta=-0.002 (CI excludes 0), L2->L2+L3 delta=-0.00155 (CI excludes 0), and L3-alone never beats META (META->L3 delta=0.0, CI includes 0). Diversity C4=-0.0052 (CI=[-0.00540,-0.00505] excludes 0) and coverage -2.3% — L3 hurts on the secondary axes too, so it cannot be rescued as a diversity play. The drop-L3 recommendation for content retrieval is statistically the most solid of the three claims. The honest scope caveat (D) is correctly stated in the probe docstring: frozen-BGE is a PROXY and the in-model KAR Gate-1/2 is the final arbiter, so 'drop' applies to content-retrieval, not necessarily the trainable model.

verdicts.strongest_objection: CLAIM B (C2, L2 incremental) is knife-edge and not robustly significant at the operational default config. The headline +7.8% rests on a net 59-of-49,998-user shift with NDCG CI_lo ~ 2.2e-5 (touching zero), and at the default k=12 pooled, 2 of 3 random seeds give CIs that include 0 (seed7: +1.5%, ns; seed42: +8.7%, ns). C2 reaches 3/3-seed significance only at k=50 and never under the maxsim lens. Practically, the L2 increment is ~7x smaller than the META->L1 jump (15% of it). So while the sign is consistent (17/21 positive, 0 significant-negative, no significant flip), 'C2 gives significant incremental value' should be DEMOTED to 'weak/directional positive, significant only at larger k' rather than asserted at the default config.
verdicts.what_would_change_my_mind: For C2 to upgrade from 'uncertain' to 'holds': at the default k=12 pooled config, show C2 CI excludes 0 across all 3 seeds (currently 2/3 fail), OR show the in-model KAR result (probe_03+) where the trainable Gate-2 assigns L2 a stable non-trivial weight with a significant downstream MAP@12/NDCG@12 lift whose CI excludes 0 — since the docstring concedes frozen-BGE is only a proxy. For C2 to be REFUTED outright: a significant negative C2 cell (none exist), or demonstration that the positive cells are driven by a handful of identifiable users (a leave-those-users-out reanalysis collapsing the delta to within CI of 0). For C3 (drop-L3) to be refuted: any single significant positive C3 cell, or an in-model run where Gate assigns L3 meaningful weight with a significant accuracy/diversity lift — neither appears anywhere in these witnesses (sig_pos=0/21)."

A_metadata_vs_llm.objection: The headline confound for A is 'L1 just adds 186 chars (META 101→L1 287, probe_04 text_lengths) and more text mechanically shifts BGE embeddings toward denser catalog regions.' This is refuted by the SAME dataset: C2 (L1→L1+L2, +176 chars) yields only +8% and C3 (+L3, +147 chars) HURTS by -13.5% (probe_01 C3 hr_pooled delta -0.00216, CI [-0.00304,-0.00132]). If added text mechanically helped retrieval, sign could not be +130%/+8%/-13.5% at near-equal added length — the monotone-length mechanism is dead. Product-name/vocabulary leakage (META already carries product_type_name, product_group_name, section_name per _compose_metadata_text) is shared by every variant and is DIFFERENCED OUT by the per-user paired ladder, so it cannot generate the increment. The C1 effect is huge and robust: META HR 0.00692 → L1+L2 0.01598, delta +0.00906, CI [+0.00790,+0.01021] excludes 0 by ~7x its half-width; in cold 2-4 bracket +0.020 (CI [+0.0142,+0.0258]). No surviving non-semantic explanation for an effect this large that is also paired-differenced against shared metadata.

B_l2_incremental.objection: B is the one claim whose confound-freedom is NOT airtight. The probe's refutation only kills a SINGLE MONOTONE length effect (L2 adds +176 chars yet helps while L3 adds chars yet hurts → sign flip). It does not exclude an INVERTED-U length contribution where text helps up to ~460 chars (L2) then hurts (L3 at 610). probe_04's own flag length_confound_refuted=True is near-tautological: code is `len_l2_add > 0` (any added text >0). The real evidence is the sign pattern, and for L2 it is FRAGILE: C2 pooled CI lower bound is +0.00022 (probe_01), i.e. it barely excludes 0; robustness shows C2 positive in only 17/21 cells with just 8/21 significant, and it flips NEGATIVE in cells like seed=7/k=12/50+ (-0.00152) and seed=42/k=50/2-4 (-0.00199). One semantic counter-point keeps me from refuting: probe_02's ISOLATED L2-only HR (0.0107) is WORSE than L1-only (0.01495), so L2 is not winning by raw verbosity — its tiny incremental value over L1 behaves semantically, not as a length artifact. Net: direction survives but a length/verbosity component cannot be cleanly subtracted from the +8%, and no matched-length neutral-filler control exists. Confound not fully ruled out.

C_drop_l3.objection: The strongest length-based attack on C is 'L3's -13.5% is just 147 more chars diluting/saturating BGE.' Ruled out three ways from the numbers. (1) Truncation artifact is impossible: L1+L2+L3 is 610 chars ≈ 111 words ≈ ~150 tokens, far below BGE max_seq_length=512 tokens (build_meta_embedding.py:102), so no clipping. (2) The harm SCALES with k and activity stratum while length is CONSTANT across them — a pure length mechanism cannot vary by k. probe_04: C3 at 50+ stratum deepens k12→k50: seed42 -0.0034→-0.0122, seed7 -0.0029→-0.0137, seed2024 -0.0020→-0.0133; pooled C3 rel goes -13.5%@k12 to ~-20%@k50. That is a semantic-dilution signature (theory/style-lineage tokens pull centroids toward generic neighbors), not length. (3) Sign opposes L2 at comparable added length (147 vs 176 chars), killing monotone length. Consistency: C3 negative in 18/21 cells, 11 significant; probe_01 pooled CI [-0.00304,-0.00132] and probe_02 C4 div delta -0.0052 (CI [-0.0054,-0.0050]) and coverage -2.3% both worsen — drop is well-supported and not length-driven.

verdicts.strongest_objection: For CLAIM B only: probe_04's headline 'Length-confound REFUTED' is over-claimed because the operative code is `length_confound_refuted = len_l2_add > 0` (witnesses/probe_04_robustness.py:149), which is true for ANY non-empty addition and proves nothing. The genuine refutation (sign flip between L2 and L3 at near-equal added char count) kills only a MONOTONE length effect; it leaves an inverted-U / saturation length contribution to L2's +8% unexcluded. Since C2's CI lower bound is +0.00022 (touching 0), is significant in only 8/21 robustness cells, and flips negative in 4/21, the small L2 increment could be partly a verbosity/text-density effect rather than perceptual semantics — there is no matched-length neutral-filler control to subtract it. The L2 claim's confound-freedom is the weak link; A and C are confound-robust.
verdicts.what_would_change_my_mind: A matched-length NEUTRAL-FILLER control: regenerate L1 embeddings with ~176 chars of semantically-empty or shuffled-attribute filler appended (matching L2's added length and the [Perceptual]-tag format) and re-score. If filler reproduces a comparable +8% HR lift, C2 is length-driven and B flips to refuted; if filler is null/negative, B's semantic claim is confirmed and moves to holds. Secondarily, for C: a per-item regression of ΔHR on (Δchars, Δtoken-count, Δunique-attribute-content) to confirm the L3 harm loads on semantic content, not length. Also replacing the tautological `len_l2_add > 0` flag with an actual partial-correlation of delta-HR vs delta-length holding layer-identity fixed would let the JSON itself carry the refutation rather than the docstring."}

A_metadata_vs_llm.objection: The construct concern does not threaten CLAIM A; if anything it works FOR it. A pure buy-similar operator should favor concrete product text (L1), so the +130% META->L1+L2 gain (probe_01 C1: 0.00692->0.01598, delta +0.00906, rel +130.9%, CI [+0.0079,+0.0102] excludes 0; NDCG rel +209.7%) is partly what the proxy is biased to reward. But the lift is enormous and CI-clean across 49,998 users, and it replicates in probe_02 (META 0.00645 -> L1+L2 0.01625). The only construct caveat is that this measures 'LLM text retrieves embedding-similar next purchases better than raw H&M metadata text' rather than 'discovery' — but META and L1 are scored under the IDENTICAL operator, so the comparison is fair and the proxy bias cannot manufacture a 2.3x gain. A holds.

B_l2_incremental.objection: The construct objection predicts L2 (perceptual, abstract style) should be PENALIZED by a buy-similar operator. The data show the opposite, which both supports CLAIM B and serves as the key control for CLAIM C. L2 ALONE beats META by +66% (probe_02: L2 0.0107 vs META/L3 both 0.00645), and L1->L1+L2 is positive in 17/21 robustness cells (8 significant), with the effect GROWING at k=50 (seed42 pooled rel +10.9% CI [+0.0018,+0.0062]; seed2024 +16.0% CI [+0.0032,+0.0078]). The headline +7.8% at k=12 (probe_01 C2 CI [+0.00022,+0.00208]) is genuinely marginal — lower bound near 0, and seed7 k=12 pooled is null (CI [-0.0012,+0.0016]). So B is real but weak at the operating point; its load-bearing role here is that an EQUALLY ABSTRACT layer thrives under the same operator, refuting the premise that the proxy structurally punishes abstraction. Length-confound refuted: L2 adds +177 chars yet helps.

C_drop_l3.objection: This is the claim the construct lens targets, and the targeted worry is REFUTED by four numbers. (1) Decoupling abstraction from noise: L2 is as abstract as L3 yet helps, while L3 ALONE equals raw metadata exactly (META->L3 delta = 0.0, CI [-0.0012,+0.0013]) and L2->L2+L3 = -14.5% (CI [-0.00275,-0.00025] excludes 0). The same operator rewards one abstract layer and is destroyed by the other, so the result is about L3 being noise, not about the proxy hating abstraction. (2) L3 is ADDITIVELY DESTRUCTIVE, not merely invisible: L1->L1+L3 = -13.4% (CI [-0.00335,-0.00055] excl 0) and L1+L2->+L3 = -13.5% (probe_01 C3 CI [-0.00304,-0.00132] excl 0). A 'proxy can't see abstraction' story predicts delta~0, not active corruption of a good centroid. (3) The discovery-flavored escape hatch fails too: on the metrics CLOSEST to discovery, L3 still loses — diversity L1+L2 0.0680 -> L1+L2+L3 0.0628 (-7.7%, CI [-0.0054,-0.0050] excl 0) and coverage 0.2194 -> 0.2144 (-2.3%). The one place L3 could have been redeemed (serendipity/coverage) is where it also loses. (4) Not an operator/cutoff artifact: C3 negative in 18/21 cells (11 sig) across 3 seeds, k=12 AND k=50, and the maxsim lens (single best-match item, not centroid: pooled k=12 C3 = -0.0027). HOLDS — but strictly scoped: as 'L3 is net-harmful as FROZEN raw text under content retrieval', which is exactly the disposition stated ('DROP L3 -> L1(+L2) method').

verdicts.strongest_objection: The construct objection's only surviving foothold is CAVEAT D, and the witnesses already concede it: HR@12-against-next-purchase via a centroid-kNN over a FROZEN encoder is a 'buy-similar' proxy that cannot reweight feature subspaces. A frozen BGE encoder embeds L3 theory-jargon as additional dimensions and averages them into the centroid with no ability to down-weight them; a TRAINABLE KAR gate (Gate-1/2) could learn to suppress the noisy L3 subspace while extracting any thin discriminative signal it carries. Therefore these probes can rigorously establish 'L3 is net-harmful as raw frozen text in content-retrieval space' (which they do, with CI-clean, multi-seed, multi-lens evidence), but they CANNOT establish the stronger 'L3 carries no learnable recommendation signal.' The drop-L3 disposition is valid for the content-retrieval method and as a strong prior, but it would over-reach if read as a verdict on L3 inside the trained model — the trainable gate, not frozen kNN, is the final arbiter, exactly as CAVEAT D states. This downgrades CLAIM C from 'L3 is useless' to 'L3 is useless-or-harmful as frozen content text, pending the gate experiment' — a scoping caveat, not a refutation, because the worry that the proxy FABRICATED the drop is itself refuted by L2 thriving and by L3 also losing on diversity/coverage.
verdicts.what_would_change_my_mind: To REFUTE CLAIM C (not just caveat it), I would need one of: (1) A trained KAR run where a learned gate over L1+L2+L3 beats L1+L2 on MAP@12/NDCG@12 with a CI excluding 0 — showing the L3 signal is recoverable once the frozen-encoder limitation is removed (this is the CAVEAT-D arbiter and the only path that overturns the disposition). (2) A discovery-native metric where L3 wins: e.g., novelty@12 / long-tail-hit-rate / serendipity restricted to items DISSIMILAR to history — currently L3 loses on diversity (-7.7%, CI excl 0) and coverage (-2.3%) too, so this would have to reverse. (3) Evidence the proxy specifically punishes abstraction — but the L2 control falsifies this: L2 (equally abstract) is +66% standalone vs META, while L3 is exactly 0.0 vs META, so the operator clearly rewards a discriminative abstract layer. (4) A stratum where L3 helps: instead it gets WORSE with activity (50+ C3 rel -27% to -39% at k=50), and the 2-4 cold-start bracket shows L3 null-to-negative (probe_01 2-4 C3 CI [-0.0033,+0.0014] includes 0; never positive-significant). Absent (1) specifically, the construct objection caveats but does not refute the drop-L3 conclusion for the content-retrieval method.

A_metadata_vs_llm.objection: C1 (META -> L1+L2) is the strongest result in the entire witness set and survives adversarial scrutiny. probe_01: HR@12 delta=+0.00906, rel_gain=+130.9%, bootstrap CI=[+0.00790, +0.01021] excludes 0 by ~7x the standard-error scale; NDCG@12 delta=+0.00272, rel_gain=+209.7%, CI=[+0.00236, +0.00308] also excludes 0. The pre-registered C1_go threshold (rel>=5% AND CI excludes 0) is cleared by a 26x margin on rel-gain, and C1_kill=false. It holds in the cold-start 2-4 bracket too: delta=+0.020, CI=[+0.0142, +0.0258], excludes 0. probe_02 replicates the magnitude on an independent 20K sample (META HR 0.00645 -> L1+L2 0.01625, ~2.5x). I have no evidence-backed objection: even my pro-L3 lens does not touch C1, because C1 is about LLM-attribute text beating raw metadata, which is orthogonal to whether L3 specifically is the right layer. A holds.

B_l2_incremental.objection: C2 (L1 -> L1+L2) clears its pre-registered bar but is materially weaker than A and the project should flag the fragility rather than over-claim. probe_01 pooled: HR@12 delta=+0.00118, rel_gain=+7.97%, CI=[+0.000220, +0.002081] -- positive but the lower bound is only ~19% of the delta away from 0, and the NDCG CI lower bound is +0.0000223, i.e. it essentially grazes zero. The cold-start 2-4 bracket CI INCLUDES zero ([-0.00028, +0.00473]), so the headline +7.8% is not significant precisely in the sparse stratum the project most cares about. probe_04 robustness: C2 is positive in 17/21 cells but significant in only 8/21, and it FLIPS NEGATIVE in several 50+/k=12 cells (seed 7: C2_rel=-14.1%; seed 42: -2.7%); it strengthens at k=50 (up to +25.9% on 50+). The length-confound is genuinely refuted (probe_04: L2 adds +177 chars yet helps, L3 adds +147 chars yet hurts -- length cannot be the driver). Net: C2 is real on average and not a length artifact, so it HOLDS, but as a fragile, regime-dependent (k- and stratum-sensitive) effect, not the robust win that C1 is. Honest framing: keep L2, but do not present +7.8% as solid in cold-start.

C_drop_l3.objection: The claim asserted by C3 is narrower than 'drop L3': the probe only shows that ADDING L3 text into a FROZEN-BGE, untrained, concatenation-then-mean-pooled centroid embedding hurts content retrieval. That is a proxy result, not a verdict on the in-model trainable KAR. The probe's own header concedes this ('frozen-BGE content-retrieval is a PROXY; the in-model trainable KAR (Gate-1/2) is the final arbiter for L3'). Mechanism of the harm is exactly the failure mode a gate fixes: score_variant() in _probe_common.py builds ONE pooled embedding per item and an unweighted mean-pool centroid per user (centroids = emb[hi].mean(axis=0)); L3's ~147 added chars dilute the L1+L2 direction with a FIXED, non-learnable weight of 1.0. The probe literally cannot down-weight L3; KAR's Factual Expert + Gate-1/Gate-2 can learn a near-zero or negative weight, recovering L1+L2 as a strict special case. So the probe at best bounds the value of NAIVELY CONCATENATING L3 at unit weight, not the value of L3 features under a learned gate. Magnitudes are modest and not catastrophic: C3 pooled HR delta=-0.00216 (rel -13.5%), CI=[-0.00304,-0.00132]; NDCG delta=-0.00039 (rel -9.7%). probe_04: C3 negative in 18/21 cells but significant in only 11/21 -- 10/21 cells are non-significant, and at k=12 the 2-4 cold-start bracket is NON-significant in all three seeds (seed42 CI includes 0; seeds 7 and 2024 give C3_delta exactly 0.0). The harm concentrates in HEAVY users at large k (50+/k=50: rel -28% to -39%), i.e. exactly where CF signal is already strongest and content retrieval matters least -- a learned gate would route those users away from L3 while the project's stated mission is the sparse/cold-start tail. Crucially L3 is NOT pure noise: probe_02 shows L3-alone NDCG@12=0.00155 > META 0.00126, and L1+L3 still beats META (HR 0.01295 vs 0.00645, ~2x), so L3 carries retrieval-relevant structure that a reasoning-aware expert could exploit. Therefore C3 does NOT license dropping L3 now; it licenses a pre-registered Gate-2 falsification test: keep L3, and kill it only if the trainable gate weight g_L3 -> 0 AND in-model MAP@12/cold-start does not improve over L1+L2. I do concede two honest limits that keep this a 'refute the over-claim', not 'L3 is great': (1) C3 IS significant and directionally consistent (18/21) in the frozen probe, and (2) probe_02 C4 shows L3 ALSO loses on the gate-independent axes -- diversity@12 -0.077 (CI [-0.0054,-0.0050], tight, excludes 0) and coverage -2.3% -- so the 'L3 buys diversity' rescue is itself refuted by the data. The surviving rescue is strictly the in-model accuracy/gating path, which the frozen probe is structurally incapable of evaluating. Verdict: C3-as-'drop-L3-from-the-project' is REFUTED as premature; C3-as-'naive-unit-weight-L3-concat-hurts-frozen-retrieval' is correct and should be reported as such.

verdicts.strongest_objection: The single strongest objection to 'drop L3' is architectural, not statistical: the probe's centroid-kNN over a frozen mean-pooled text embedding (score_variant in _probe_common.py: per-item single vector, per-user unweighted mean centroid) assigns L3 a FIXED weight of 1.0 and has no mechanism to discount it. KAR's whole point is a trainable Factual Expert + Gate-1/Gate-2 that can learn weight ~0 for L3, making L1+L2 a recoverable special case. So C3's -13.5% HR bounds the cost of NAIVE unit-weight L3 concatenation, not the value of L3 under learning. This is corroborated by L3 not being noise (probe_02: L3-alone NDCG 0.00155 > META 0.00126; L1+L3 HR 0.01295 ~2x META), by the harm concentrating in heavy/large-k users (50+/k=50: rel -28% to -39%) rather than the cold-start tail the project targets (2-4/k=12 C3 non-significant in all 3 seeds, delta=0.0 in two), and by 10/21 probe_04 cells being non-significant. Hence L3 should be retained as a PRE-REGISTERED Gate-2 falsification target (kill iff learned g_L3->0 and no in-model cold-start lift over L1+L2), not dropped on frozen-proxy evidence.
verdicts.what_would_change_my_mind: I would concede 'drop L3' if EITHER: (1) An in-model run reported the learned Gate-1/Gate-2 weight on the L3-bearing Factual text driving g_L3 to ~0 AND the full L1+L2+L3 KAR failing to beat an L1+L2 KAR on MAP@12/HR@12 in the cold-start strata (1, 2-4) with CIs excluding 0 -- i.e. the trainable arbiter itself, not the frozen proxy, falsifies L3. That witness does not exist yet; the probes explicitly defer to it. OR (2) probe evidence showing L3's harm is present and significant SPECIFICALLY in the sparse strata that the project exists to serve -- but the data shows the opposite: at k=12 the 2-4 bracket C3 is non-significant across all three seeds (seed42 CI=[-0.0033,+0.0014] includes 0; seeds 7 and 2024 C3_delta=0.0), while the significant damage is in 50+/k=50 (-28% to -39%), the CF-rich regime. OR (3) evidence that L3 is statistically indistinguishable from noise on every axis -- but probe_02 refutes this (L3-alone NDCG 0.00155 > META 0.00126; L1+L3 ~2x META HR). Absent any of these, the frozen probe over-reaches; the diversity/coverage rescue for L3 is, I concede, already dead (probe_02 C4: diversity -7.7% CI excludes 0, coverage -2.3%), so the ONLY live rescue is the untested in-model gating path -- which is exactly why L3 should be held to a Gate-2 test rather than dropped.

A_metadata_vs_llm.objection: No viable alternative reading defeats C1. probe_01 C1 (META->L1+L2) lifts pooled HR@12 0.00692->0.01598 (delta=+0.00906, rel=+130.9%, CI=[+0.00790,+0.01021], excludes 0, n=49998); NDCG rel=+209.7% CI=[+0.00236,+0.00308]. Even the most adversarial decomposition keeps it: L1 ALONE (probe_02 HR=0.01495) already more than doubles META (0.00645), and L3-alone HR=0.00645 = META exactly, so the gain is real LLM signal, not a length artifact (probe_04 length-confound REFUTED: L2 adds +177 chars and helps, L3 adds +147 and hurts). The only nuance the alternative can extract is that the META->L1+L2 lift is ~entirely an L1 effect, not an L1+L2 effect, which strengthens rather than refutes C1 and merely reframes credit toward L1. C1 holds under every reading.

B_l2_incremental.objection: The alternative 'L2 is within noise' has real traction at the pre-registered operating point but is overstated as a full refutation. The headline 'C2 ~+7.8%, CI excludes 0' is WRONG as a characterization of the canonical cell: probe_01 C2 hr_pooled CI=[+0.00022,+0.00208] (n=49998, the 50k run) does exclude 0, BUT the robustness grid's k=12 pooled cells mostly do NOT: seed42 CI=[-0.00020,+0.00300], seed7 CI=[-0.00120,+0.00160] rel=+1.5%, maxsim42 CI=[-0.00668,+0.00800]; only seed2024 k=12 excludes 0. So 3 of 4 k=12 pooled cells include 0, and seed7 trips the project's OWN pre-registered C2_weak rule (rel<2% or CI incl 0 -> demote to cold-start-only). L2-only also HURTS some strata (seed7 k12 50+: -14.1%; seed42 k12 50+: -2.7%). HOWEVER the alternative cannot claim pure noise: aggregate 17/21 cells positive, 8/21 sig; at k=50 all 6 centroid pooled+50+ cells are SIG-positive (rel +11% to +26%); length-confound refuted. Correct reading: L2 adds a SMALL, DIRECTIONALLY-ROBUST but k-FRAGILE increment, NOT a clean '+7.8% CI-excludes-0' result. The 50k-run CI excludes 0 only because n=50k; at the reported 20k/k=12 grid it is borderline. B should be stated as 'L2 = small real gain, significance depends on k and sample size' — not as a crisp positive.

C_drop_l3.objection: The alternative 'L3 just needs a different encoder, not deletion' is the weakest of the three and is not supported by any number in these probes. For the claim AS SCOPED (content retrieval with frozen BGE), drop-L3 is correct: L3 is negative in 18/21 cells, SIG-negative in 11/21, and 0/21 cells EVER show L3 significantly helping (no CI strictly >0). Harm is monotone in k (k=12 pooled rel: -9.0/-11.4/-13.5%; k=50 pooled: -18.0/-20.3/-21.7%) and worst for heavy users (50+ up to -39.1%). L3-alone HR=0.00645 == META (delta exactly 0.0, CI=[-0.0012,+0.0013]) -> L3 carries literally zero net retrieval signal in BGE space; it only DILUTES the L1/L2 centroid (L2->L2+L3: -14.5% CI=[-0.00275,-0.00025]; L1->L1+L3: -13.4% CI=[-0.00335,-0.00055]). Diversity AND coverage also drop (C4: div -7.7% CI excl 0, cov -2.3%), so there is no diversity-rescue either. The 'different encoder' escape is NOT refuted by content — it is simply OUT OF SCOPE here and explicitly deferred to CAVEAT D (trainable KAR Gate-1/2). Within the stated content-retrieval claim, dropping L3 is the right and well-supported call; the alternative survives only as an unfalsified-but-unsupported future-work conjecture, not a present reading of the data.

verdicts.strongest_objection: The single most defensible alternative-reading attack is on CLAIM B's HEADLINE, not its direction. The brief states 'L2 ~+7.8% HR@12; CI lower bound very close to 0.' The robustness grid shows that at the pre-registered k=12 operating point, 3 of 4 pooled cells have CIs that INCLUDE 0 (seed42 [-0.00020,+0.00300], seed7 [-0.00120,+0.00160] at rel=+1.5%, maxsim [-0.00668,+0.00800]), and the project's own C2_weak kill-rule (rel<2% OR CI-includes-0) FIRES on seed7. The +7.8%/CI-excludes-0 result is an artifact of the 50k-user run (probe_01, n=49998) where power is highest; re-seeded 20k runs do not reproduce CI-exclusion at k=12. So 'L2 gives a clear incremental gain at the deployed k' is an OVERREACH; the defensible statement is 'L2 gives a small gain that is only significant at larger n or larger k.' This does not flip the 2-layer reframe (L1+L2 is still the best variant: L1+L2 HR=0.01625 > L1 0.01495 > L1+L2+L3 0.01405), but it means B should be reported with the k/n-dependence caveat, not as a settled positive.
verdicts.what_would_change_my_mind: For B: a k=12 pooled C2 CI that excludes 0 across ALL three seeds (not just seed 2024 and the 50k run) — currently 2 of 4 such cells include 0 — would upgrade B from 'uncertain' to 'holds'; conversely, a fourth+ independent seed at k=12 with rel<2% and CI including 0 would push it toward 'refuted as a deployed-k effect.' For C: any single robustness cell where adding L3 yields a CI strictly >0 (currently 0/21), OR a re-encoding of L3 text (e.g., E5/fine-tuned encoder or a different L3 composition) that raises L3-alone HR above META's 0.00645 baseline, would substantiate the 'different encoder not deletion' alternative and move C to 'uncertain'; absent that, CAVEAT D (the trainable KAR gate down-weighting rather than deleting L3) is the only honest escape hatch and must be reported as the arbiter, since frozen-BGE content retrieval is explicitly a proxy. For A: nothing realistic — it would take META catching L1+L2, which contradicts L1-alone already doubling META.
